story.titleZh: F1车队面临马德里赛道策略难题
story.summaryZh: 据The 比赛报道，马德里赛道存在轮胎退化严重和进站耗时约24秒的问题，使F1车队在西班牙大奖赛策略选择上陷入两难。
story.originalTitle: F1 teams face big Madring strategy dilemma
story.summaryEn: According to The Race, the Madring circuit suffers from severe tyre degradation and a pit stop loss time of around 24 seconds, leaving F1 teams in a dilemma over strategy for the Spanish Grand Prix.
detailZh: F1并不真的会迎来乔治·拉塞尔在首次练习赛后半开玩笑地提到的六停西班牙大奖赛。
但轮胎供应商倍耐力表示，F1最新赛道的多种因素结合意味着策略将特别难以制定。
事实上，周五练习赛后的初步预测是，车队在决定最佳方案时将陷入进退两难的境地。
超长的维修区导致进站损失时间约为24秒，这阻碍了轮胎更换，意味着最合理的路线应该是一停。
但轮胎的高热退化水平，尤其是极具挑战性的前左胎粒化，意味着两停是明智的。
这两种选择之间没有中间地带，所以问题不是选择什么是最佳策略，而是哪个是最不坏的。
首次练习赛后，F1车队对轮胎退化看起来相当极端感到瞠目结舌。
高抓地力沥青（据倍耐力称是本赛季最高的）、光滑的表面和高速弯道的结合意味着赛车打滑严重——这在第一节练习赛中引发了一些令人担忧的发现。
正如拉塞尔所说：“在新沥青上，抓地力很高，但你会打滑得很厉害，这通常是一种可能。”
“考虑到我们在FP1中的退化，六停比赛本来是最快的方式。FP2稍好一些，我相信周日的比赛会更好。但这是最大的问号。”
从倍耐力的角度来看，随着西班牙大奖赛周末的继续，车手和车队将不得不管理两个问题——而且这两个问题都不简单。
最复杂的问题是前左胎粒化，这是由于光滑表面和高抓地力的结合意味着橡胶容易达到峰值应力，表面实际上被撕裂。
前胎粒化会引发弯中转向不足，随后性能下降。在马德里赛道所特有的高速弯道中，这比在低速场地更难管理。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在周五赛后表示，这一因素一直是练习中最大的头痛问题。
“管理轮胎粒化一直是一场噩梦，”他说。“通常整个周末会好转，但我们只能等着看能好转多少。”
在马德里赛道，不仅仅是前胎难以处理，因为高速弯道和赛车几乎不断转弯的方式意味着后胎也会过热。
把这两个因素放在一起，结果就是高退化。
倍耐力首席工程师西蒙尼·贝拉认为，这里的性能下降处于“非常高”的水平——根据FP2中一些长距离跑的数据，约为每圈0.2-0.3秒。
“出现这样的数值令人惊讶，”他说。“它们超出了我们的预期范围。”
虽然一般的赛道演变和改进的调校应该有助于在比赛到来时降低这一数字，但西班牙大奖赛将成为一场轮胎策略至关重要的比赛。
这就是为什么除奥迪外，所有车队在周五练习赛后都选择保留两套硬胎——因为这很可能是周日最耐用的选择。
贝拉表示，前胎粒化和过热带来的不可预测性，加上退化水平，意味着规划正确的比赛路径将很难确定。
“我不想排除任何情况，”他说。“我认为从数据来看，你会认为车队会选择两停，因为退化非常高。”
“但进站损失是24秒，所以我相当确定一些车队会尝试以一次进站为目标。”
“这意味着我们最终可能会面临不同的情况，一些车队尝试一停，另一些车队尝试两停。”
目前哪条路线最好尚不清楚，而且超车可能有多困难使事情进一步复杂化。
因为尽管新的动力单元意味着部署偏移可以在某些场地使超车比过去更容易，但同样陷入车阵也有不利之处。
贝拉补充说：“如果你在车流中，你会损失相当多的性能，而且你也会毁掉轮胎，因为你失去了载荷，并且在打滑时产生高温。”
“所以，我们有不同的因素推动车队走向不同的方向。”
“这不容易；事实上，相当复杂。”
detailEn: Formula 1 isn't really heading for the six-stopper Spanish Grand Prix that George Russell half joked was on the cards after opening practice.
But tyre supplier Pirelli says a combination of factors at F1's newest venue means strategy is going to be particularly tricky to work out.
In fact, the initial prediction following Friday's running is that teams are going to be stuck between a rock and a hard place when working out what is best to do.
The super-long pitlane, which has left the pitstop loss time at around 24 seconds, is a deterrent for tyre changes and means the most logical route should be a one-stopper.
But high levels of thermal degradation of the rubber, and particularly challenging front left graining, means that a two-stop would be sensible.
With no middle ground between those two choices, it is not going to be a case of what is the best strategy to pick. It is about which is the least bad.
F1 teams were left wide-eyed after opening practice when the tyre degradation looked pretty extreme.

A combination of high grip asphalt (highest of the season according to Pirelli), a smooth surface and fast corners has meant cars are sliding a lot – and that triggered some alarming findings during that first session.
As Russell said: "It's often a possibility on new tarmacs that the grip is very high but you're sliding quite aggressively.
"With the deg we had in FP1, a six-stop race would have been the fastest way. FP2 was slightly better and I'm sure the race on Sunday will be better again. But that's the biggest question mark."
From Pirelli's perspective, there are two issues that drivers and teams are going to have to manage as the Spanish GP weekend continues – and neither is particularly straightforward.

The most complex issue is front left graining, which is being generated because the combination of the smooth surface and high grip means the rubber hits peak stress easily and the surface effectively tears.

Front graining triggers mid-corner understeer and a subsequent drop in performance. It is much harder to manage on the kind of high-speed corners that feature at the Madring than it is at low-speed venues.
Oscar Piastri said after Friday that this element had been the biggest headache from running.
"It's been a nightmare to try and manage the tyres with graining," he said. "It normally gets better through a weekend, but we'll have to wait and see how much better."

It is not just the fronts that are proving to be hard to deal with around the Madring, because the high-speed corners and the way the cars are almost constantly in turns means that the rears are overheating too.
Throw these two elements together and the result is high degradation.
Pirelli chief engineer Simone Berra reckoned that the drop off here was at a "very high" level – around 0.2-0.3 seconds per lap based on some of the long runs in FP2.
"It was a surprise to have these kinds of values," he said. "They were outside our range of expectations."

While general track evolution and improved set-ups should help reduce that figure by the time the race comes around, the scene is set for the Spanish GP turning into a race where tyre strategy will be critical.
That is what has fuelled all teams apart from Audi electing to keep two hard tyres back after Friday practice – as that could well be the most resilient option for Sunday.

Berra said that the unpredictability thrown up by the front graining and overheating, plus the levels of the degradation, meant that plotting the right path through the race was going to be tough to nail.
"I don't want to exclude any kind of situation," he said. "I think looking from the data, you would think that the teams will go for a two-stop because the degradation is very high.
"But the pitstop loss is 24 seconds, so I'm pretty sure that some teams will try to reach as a target the one-stop race.
"It means we could end up in different situations, with some teams trying the one-stop and other teams trying the two-stops."
Which route is best is unclear right now, and matters are further complicated by how difficult it could be to overtake.
For even though the new power units mean deployment offsets can make passes easier at some venues than in the past, equally there are downsides to falling into the pack.
Berra added: "If you are in traffic, you lose quite a lot of performance, and you also destroy your tyres because you lose load and you generate high temperatures as you're sliding.
"So, we have different factors that are pushing teams towards different directions.
"It's not easy; in fact, it is pretty complicated."
keyPointsZh: 马德里赛道超长维修区导致进站损失约24秒，阻碍了轮胎更换，最合理路线本应是一停。
但轮胎热退化严重，尤其是前左胎粒化，使得两停变得明智。
两种选择之间没有中间地带，问题不是选最佳策略，而是选最不坏的策略。

However, high levels of thermal degradation, particularly front left graining, make a two-stop sensible.
With no middle ground between the two choices, it is not about picking the best strategy but the least bad one.

relatedItems.titleZh: 墨西哥大奖赛最终练习赛发生的情况
relatedItems.summaryZh: 兰多·诺里斯和基米·安东内利在墨西哥大奖赛最终练习赛中表现接近，而法拉利的速度在排位赛之前有所下降。
relatedItems.originalTitle: What happened in F1 Mexican GP final practice
detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯和基米·安东内利在墨西哥大奖赛最终练习赛中表现接近，而法拉利的速度在排位赛之前有所下降。
周五的领跑者查尔斯·勒克莱尔最终以第三名的成绩结束练习，但这是在软胎排位赛模拟尝试失败后。
勒克莱尔和队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿在FP3开始时交换了最快时间，就像他们的练习一样。
梅赛德斯是第一个切换到软胎的领跑者之一，乔治·罗素在考虑是否需要双准备圈，告诉车队考虑告诉安东内利在单圈热身之后加力，安东内利确实完成了两圈准备圈，并以1m17.601s的成绩成为最快。
那看起来将是本节练习赛的最佳时间，直到距离一小时练习赛结束还有两分钟时，诺里斯提升了成绩，比之前快了一千分之一，为麦克拉伦车队创造了新纪录。
勒克莱尔以0.117秒的差距排在第三位，这表明法拉利在排位赛中仍将是争夺杆位的竞争者，而奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在第四位结束本节练习赛，仅比他的领队队友慢两十分之一。
维斯塔潘在比赛后期抱怨刹车问题，以三又四分之一的十分之一秒的差距排在第五位，领先汉密尔顿， 法拉利 在第六位，差距不到七百分之一，而 小红牛 的两位车手再次都位于理论上的 Q3 分界线之内。
林德布拉德和第九快的劳森在中游对手中领先很多，尼科·胡肯伯格在奥迪车队落后四十分之一秒，排在阿尔皮纳车队双胞胎弗朗科·科拉皮托和皮埃尔·加斯利以及费尔南多·阿隆索的阿斯顿·马丁车队之前。
霍肯伯格在这次练习中（32圈）与Ryo Hirakawa并列创造了最高圈数，Hirakawa被紧急调换到第二辆哈斯赛车，在本周末的剩余时间里取代了奥康的位置。
Hirakawa完成了整个计划，包括很多单圈推力的机会，在结束了一个使用三套软胎的练习后，他最好的成绩是1分19.504秒，这使他排在第19位，比最佳成绩慢了1.904秒，比队友Ollie 贝尔曼慢了六十分之一秒。
本土车手Sergio Perez是两位未能设置成绩的车手之一，另一位是奥迪的博托莱托。
Perez只完成了一圈安装圈数后，就回到了凯迪拉克维修区，车队在排位赛之前选择了进行预防性的引擎更换。
他的队友瓦尔特里·博塔斯排在第20位，比领先者慢2.742秒，落后于平川0.838秒。
14 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+1.250秒
detailEn: Lando Norris and Kimi Antonelli were near-inseparable in final practice for Formula 1's Mexican Grand Prix as Ferrari's pace faltered ahead of qualifying.
Friday pacesetter Charles Leclerc ultimately ended up third for Ferrari, but only at the end of the session following aborted attempts at his qualifying simulation on soft tyres.
He and team-mate Lewis Hamilton - whose session played out in a similar way - had traded fastest times at the beginning of FP3 as the top teams all chose to start the session on medium tyres.

Mercedes was among the first of the frontrunners to switch to softs and while George Russell pondered whether a double-prep lap was necessary, telling the team to consider telling Antonelli to push after a single warm-up lap, Antonelli did complete two prep laps and duly went fastest with a 1m17.601s.
That looked as though it would stand as the session's best time until Norris improved with two minutes left of the hour-long session, going one thousandth quicker for McLaren.

Leclerc was 0.117s back in third, suggesting the Ferrari will remain a contender for pole in qualifying, while Oscar Piastri ended the session within two tenths of his pacesetting McLaren team-mate in fourth.

Max Verstappen complained of brake issues late on and was three and a half tenths down in fifth ahead of Hamilton, with less than seven hundredths covering the Ferrari in sixth and Arvid Lindblad at the back of the top 10, as Racing Bulls again had both drivers inside the theoretical Q3 cutoff.

Lindblad and ninth-fastest Lawson were well clear of their midfield rivals, with Nico Hulkenberg four tenths further back for Audi ahead of Alpine duo Franco Colapinto and Pierre Gasly and Fernando Alonso's Aston Martin.

Hulkenberg set the joint-highest number of laps in the session (32) alongside Ryo Hirakawa, parachuted in to the second Haas seat for the remainder of the weekend with Esteban Ocon replaced ahead of FP3.

Hirakawa ran through a full programme including plenty of opportunities for single push laps, and by the end of a session where he used three sets of softs had a best time of 1m19.504s that left him 19th, 1.904s off the pace and inside six tenths of team-mate Ollie Bearman.
Home driver Sergio Perez was one of two drivers, alongside Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto, who failed to set a time.
Perez completed just one installation lap before returning to the Cadillac garage, where the team opted to make a precautionary engine change before qualifying.
His team-mate Valtteri Bottas was 20th, 2.742s off the pace and 0.838s behind Hirakawa.
14 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +1.250s

relatedItems.titleZh: 哈贾尔因推搡围场访客获正式警告
relatedItems.summaryZh: 红牛车手伊萨克·哈贾尔因在墨西哥大奖赛第一次练习赛前推搡一名围场访客，被F1赛会干事给予正式警告。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hadjar escapes with warning for pushing Mexico F1 paddock guest
relatedItems.summaryEn: Red Bull driver Isack Hadjar has been given a formal warning for pushing a paddock guest ahead of the first Formula 1 practice session at the Mexican Grand Prix.
detailZh: 伊萨克·哈贾尔因在墨西哥大奖赛第一次练习赛前推搡一名围场访客，被给予正式警告。
社交媒体周五流传的视频显示，哈贾尔推搡了一名试图与他自拍的人。
这名红牛车手随后于周六上午被叫去见F1赛会干事，传唤文件将此事描述为“涉嫌不当行为”。
哈贾尔在赛会干事面前表示，他当时正赶着去参加第一次练习赛，在停下来与一名年轻车迷合影后，被一名围场访客以带有攻击性的方式接近。
干事文件详细记录了该事件的经过，并写道“一名安保人员当时走在哈贾尔身后，未能
介入并阻止这一等同于侵犯车手私人空间的行为”。
哈贾尔起初对这一举动进行了抵抗，随后“用张开的右手将他推到一边”——这违反了国际汽联国际体育法典第12.2.1.l条关于不当行为的规定。
然而，在仅给予警告的处罚时，干事依据国际体育法典附录B中的指导原则，认可了五项对哈贾尔有利的减轻情节。
这些情况是：哈贾尔当时“在回应另一人未经邀请且相当激进的举动”；他正试图穿过拥挤区域前往红牛车库参加第一节练习；现场没有“足够”的安保人员；那名嘉宾未经同意侵入了他的个人空间；以及车手们在围场内通行时面临的“普遍问题”。
detailEn: Isack Hadjar has been given a formal warning for pushing a guest in the paddock ahead of the first Formula 1 practice session at the Mexican Grand Prix.
Footage circulated on social media on Friday that appeared to show Hadjar pushing someone who had tried to take a selfie with him.
The Red Bull driver was subsequently called to see the F1 stewards on Saturday morning for what the summons document described as 'alleged misconduct'.

Hadjar stated in his appearance in front of the stewards that he was running late for FP1 and, having stopped for a photograph with a young fan, was "approached by a paddock guest in an aggressive manner".
The stewards' document detailing that account also said "one security person was walking behind him [Hadjar] and was unable to
intervene and prevent what was tantamount to an invasion of the driver's private space".
Having initially resisted that move, Hadjar subsequently "pushed him aside with his open right hand" - a breach of article 12.2.1.l of the FIA international sporting code relating to misconduct.
However, in awarding only a warning the stewards acknowledge five mitigating circumstances in Hadjar's favour, in line with the guidelines in appendix B of the ISC.

These were that Hadjar was "reacting to an uninvited and rather aggressive action by another person"; that he was trying to make his way to the Red Bull garage for FP1 through a congested area; that he did not have "sufficient" security present; that the guest invaded his personal space without consent; and the "general issue" drivers have moving through the paddock.
keyPointsZh: 社交媒体周五流传的视频显示，哈贾尔推搡了一名试图与他自拍的人。
哈贾尔向赛会干事表示，他当时正赶着去参加第一次练习赛，在停下来与一名年轻车迷合影后，被一名围场访客以带有攻击性的方式接近。
keyPointsEn: Footage circulated on social media on Friday appeared to show Hadjar pushing someone who had tried to take a selfie with him.
Hadjar told the stewards he was running late for FP1 and, after stopping for a photograph with a young fan, was "approached by a paddock guest in an aggressive manner".

relatedItems.titleZh: 哈斯墨西哥站余下赛程由平川亮替换奥康
relatedItems.summaryZh: 哈斯车队在周六上午突然宣布，储备车手平川亮将取代埃斯特班·奥康出战墨西哥大奖赛余下赛程，奥康因此缺席本站剩余比赛。车队未说明换人原因，但确认并非奥康生病。

relatedItems.originalTitle: Ocon suddenly replaced at Haas for rest of Mexico F1 weekend
relatedItems.summaryEn: Haas unexpectedly announced on Saturday morning that reserve driver Ryo Hirakawa will replace Esteban Ocon for the remainder of the Mexico City Grand Prix. No reason was given for the change, but the team confirmed it is not due to illness for Ocon.
detailZh: 埃斯特班·奥康将缺席F1墨西哥大奖赛余下赛程，哈斯储备车手平川亮将替换他。
哈斯在周六上午出人意料地发布了一份简短声明，宣布了这一换人决定。
声明写道：“TGR哈斯F1车队储备车手平川亮将在本周墨西哥城大奖赛余下赛程中替换埃斯特班·奥康。”
“平川亮曾随丰田Gazoo Racing两次赢得FIA世界耐力锦标赛冠军，并赢得勒芒24小时耐力赛冠军。他于10月30日星期五在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道参加了第一节练习赛，这是他本赛季第三次驾驶VF-26参加自由练习，总排名第15。
这位日本车手将在周六的最后一节练习和排位赛以及周日71圈的大奖赛中与队友奥利·贝尔曼搭档——这将是平川的F1正赛首秀。
目前不会发表进一步声明。
此次更换未给出任何原因，但哈斯车队已确认并非因为奥康生病。
因此，合理的推断是他似乎已被安排坐冷板凳。
奥康与哈斯车队关系破裂的所有原因
奥康在墨西哥经历了一个令人沮丧的周五，在第二次自由练习中公开表达了对自己的运行计划的不满——这是他当天唯一一节驾驶赛车的时间，此前平川亮在第一次自由练习中出场，以满足新秀练习规则。
他的圈速并不差——在第二次自由练习中从平川亮手中拿回赛车后，奥康击败了队友奥利·贝尔曼，最终位列第13名，成绩尚可——但他与工程师劳拉·穆勒在无线电中出现了摩擦。
劳拉·穆勒：我们把高油量运行换成了中性胎，因为奥利的轮胎状况不太好。
埃斯特班·奥康：还在用软胎，对吧？
LM：不，我们得用中性胎。
EO：不，不，我想要软胎，别这样对我。拜托。
奥康在练习结束后在围场里明显不满，他戴着头盔回到了哈斯车队的接待区。
哈斯车队已经决定在2027年用法拉利青训车手拉斐尔·卡马拉替换奥康，并在9月底宣布了奥康的离队。
卡马拉击败了丰田支持的平川亮等车手，锁定了这个席位。
这位31岁的新秀会是丰田的下一位F1车手吗？
两届WEC冠军平川亮自2024年底以来已为迈凯伦、阿尔派和哈斯完成多次F1练习赛出场，并长期表示目标是参加F1比赛。
他将成为自2014年比利时大奖赛时年32岁的安德烈·洛特勒代表卡特汉姆车队出战以来，最年长的F1首秀车手。
该车队对其巴西下一站的车手阵容不予置评，这与其声明保持一致。
detailEn: Esteban Ocon will sit out the rest of Formula 1's Mexican Grand Prix with Haas reserve driver Ryo Hirakawa replacing him.
Haas unexpectedly released a short statement on Saturday morning announcing the switch.
"TGR Haas F1 team reserve driver Ryo Hirakawa will replace Esteban Ocon for the remainder of the weekend's Mexico City Grand Prix," the statement read.

"Hirakawa, a two-time winner of the FIA World Endurance Championship and 24 Hours of Le Mans Winner with Toyota Gazoo Racing, participated in FP1 at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez on Friday 30 October - his third free practice outing of the season driving the VF-26, finishing 15th overall.
"The Japanese driver will partner team-mate Ollie Bearman through final practice and qualifying on Saturday and Sunday's 71-lap grand prix - Hirakawa's Formula 1 race debut.
"No further statements will be made at this time."
No reason has been given for the change but Haas has confirmed it is not due to illness for Ocon.
It is logical therefore to reason that he appears to have been benched.
All the reasons the Ocon-Haas relationship fell apart

Ocon had a frustrating Friday in Mexico, publicly expressing his dissatisfaction with his runplan in FP2 - his only session in the car, after Hirakawa drove in FP1 to satisfy the rookie practice rule.

His time was not bad - after getting the car back off Hirakawa for FP2, Ocon beat team-mate Ollie Bearman to end up a respectable 13th - but there was friction on the radio with his engineer Laura Mueller.
Laura Mueller: We've swapped the high fuel run to medium because Ollie's [tyre] appearance is not great.
Esteban Ocon: Still doing soft, right?
LM: No, we have to do medium.
EO: No, no, I wanted the soft, like, don't do that to me. Come on.
Ocon was visibly dissatisfied in the paddock after the session, keeping his helmet on as he returned to Haas's hospitality unit.
Haas has already decided to replace Ocon with Ferrari junior Rafael Camara for 2027, announcing his exit at the end of September.
Camara beat the likes of Toyota-backed driver Hirakawa to secure the seat.
Is this 31-year-old rookie Toyota's next F1 driver?
Two-time WEC champion Hirakawa has completed multiple F1 practice outings for McLaren, Alpine and Haas since the end of 2024, with a long-stated aim of racing in F1.
He will become the oldest F1 debutant since then-32-year-old Andre Lotterer drove for Caterham at the Belgian GP in 2014.
The team is making no comment on its driver line-up for the next race in Brazil, in keeping with its statement.
keyPointsZh: 平川亮曾在丰田Gazoo Racing赢得两次FIA世界耐力锦标赛冠军和勒芒24小时耐力赛冠军。
平川亮周五第一节练习赛驾驶VF-26排名第15，这是他本赛季第三次自由练习出场。
平川亮将在周六最后一场练习赛和排位赛以及周日71圈正赛中搭档奥利·贝尔曼，这将是他F1正赛首秀。
keyPointsEn: Hirakawa is a two-time FIA World Endurance Championship winner and a 24 Hours of Le Mans winner with Toyota Gazoo Racing.
Hirakawa finished 15th overall in FP1 at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez on Friday 30 October, his third free practice outing of the season in the VF-26.
Hirakawa will partner Ollie Bearman through final practice and qualifying on Saturday and Sunday's 71-lap grand prix, which will be his Formula 1 race debut.
